text_block_list.text:
It's just that, well, I was chatting with a
friend
yesterday, and we got carried
away...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I dropped her off in Tata just before
curfew...
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
But that was yesterday, and this is today.
It's all
good in the neighborhood!
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, Марузенски
definitely
needs some more sleЭпизод
text_block_list.name: Монолог
